title: Craft Workflow Interaction Definition drift audit

findings.condition: Workflow placement policy was previously scoped as shared CyberAlchemy Lab governance.
findings.remediation: Use Craft-owned definition IDs and role ownership while retaining shared Authority and Gate as external dependencies.

findings.condition: Decision Bundle mixed interaction presentation with governance aggregation.
findings.remediation: Use Decision Request Set for presentation only; each member remains an independently governed decision.

findings.condition: The five exact CyberAlchemy-v2 and DomainSpec/Craft selectors are current but unadmitted in CyberAlchemy Lab.
findings.remediation: Obtain source-admission decisions before promotion review.

findings.condition: The selected architecture names the role, but the admitted Lab owner registry does not bind it to an accountable principal.
findings.remediation: Bind the exact role and scope without collapsing it into definition-owner authority.

claim_ceiling: This audit records candidate ownership correction and open dependencies. It does not admit Craft vocabulary or select a bounded context.
